<!-- pr-reviewer: 854a3af014aeadb9b23bfa3c6696d3f3b79d301b -->
Needs changes before merge.

The local trial merge is clean. This head contains upstream `main` at `abe24ff09d789757399cfcdf5f43c53ad9f9cbfb`.
The script bridge uses the existing MCP checks and command history. The catalog tests check regenerated NC output byte for byte.

Local results:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 109/109 steps passed. This includes the CLI, scripting, catalog, UI renderer, and xtask suites.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 1,065 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed without warnings.
- The off-screen renderer passed on the software Vulkan adapter.

Safety checks:
- I read all 369 lines of the new NC file. No existing golden file changed.
- I changed `G21` to `G20` in the catalog NC file. Both catalog tests failed. Both passed after restoration.
- I restored `script/mod.rs` from upstream main. The new `cam.call` test failed with `TypeError: not a callable function`. It passed after restoration.

Requested before merge:
1. `xtask/src/catalog_media.rs:42`: Convert the screenshot output path to an absolute path before you start the renderer. The code keeps a relative path, but the renderer runs from `crates/ui`. I reproduced this with `../review-2447-shots`. The renderer wrote `crates/review-2447-shots/2d/first-part/first-part.png` inside the source tree. The caller's outside output directory stayed empty. The collection step therefore searches the wrong directory. Use the same absolute path for directory creation, rendering, and collection. Add a regression test with a relative path to a new outside directory.

Live PDF conversion was not tested. All mutation changes and temporary PNG files were removed. The worktree is clean.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Relative screenshot output path in `xtask/src/catalog_media.rs`.

The output directory is resolved to an absolute path before creation. Rendering and collection use that same path.

`catalog_screenshots_resolves_new_relative_outside_directory` pins a new `../new-shots` directory, the absolute renderer path, output outside the source tree, and successful image collection. Mutation check: reverting the fix failed because collection found no PNGs; restoring it passed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 109 steps passed, 0 failed.
`cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

New head: fb11921ceec326f493a785edbfca60315e0b3fdc.
Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: fb11921ceec326f493a785edbfca60315e0b3fdc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The previous finding is resolved. The screenshot command resolves the output directory before it starts the renderer. Directory creation, rendering, and image collection use the same absolute path. The new test checks a new relative directory outside the source tree.

The local trial merge with upstream `main` at `c0c92ee865ae3c19a5bd4e8d7904c8ad2b5b29c7` is clean. I checked the current upstream laws. The script bridge uses the existing MCP validation and command history. This PR adds UI test tooling. It does not change a screen, so before/after screenshots do not apply.

Local results:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 108 of 109 steps passed. All selected app suites and the catalog UI suite passed. The xtask unit suite had 157 passes and one failure.
- The sole gate failure also occurs on unmodified upstream `main`. I reproduced it in a separate temporary checkout with `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask gate_maps_tests::no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app -- --exact`.
- The failure is in an upstream test file that this PR does not change:
  ```text
  Gate maps naming moved modules as app::<module>: ["lathe_post_thread_dips: app::post"]
  ```
- `cargo test -p xtask --test catalog`: all 4 tests passed. I ran this separately because the unit failure stopped the gate before this suite.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 1,067 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed without warnings.
- The off-screen catalog render passed on the software Vulkan adapter. Its output went to a temporary directory outside the source tree.

Safety checks:
- I read all 369 lines of the new NC file. No existing golden file changed.
- I changed `G21` to `G20` in the catalog NC file. Both catalog tests failed. Both passed after restoration.
- I restored `script/mod.rs` from upstream main. The `cam.call` test failed with `TypeError: not a callable function`. It passed after restoration.
- I reverted the screenshot path fix. The new regression test failed because image collection found no PNGs. It passed after restoration.

Requested before merge: none. The earlier path finding is closed by this review.

Live PDF conversion was not tested. The full quick gate remains red because of the reproduced upstream failure above. All mutation changes were restored. No review image or log was committed to the PR branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
